messages:
Alisa (eng-sec): quick check — we need to lock a fieldwork slot for the KMS/HSM runbook verification. auditors want 2 hours on Thu morning. who owns the smoke?
Michael P: I can own the smoke tests but need staging keystore ready by Wed EOD.
Rajesh: staging keystore is blocked on the service account perms change (IAM ticket #4592). Ops said they'll do it by tomorrow.
Sara Ops: confirming — I put the IAM change in the queue this morning. ETA EOD tomorrow. tagging @Rajesh in the ticket for validation. :white_check_mark:
Kevin - DevEx: FYI, the runbook references the new rotation playbook — updated doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation-v2 (please read the NOTES section).
Alisa (eng-sec): thanks Kevin — during the run we'll need sample audit logs exported. Michael, can your smoke include a short export and verify cloudwatch -> audit-ingest?
Michael P: yes. plan: 1) smoke key create 2) rotate 3) export logs -> confirm ingest. should be ~25m.
Rajesh: note — HSM integration test requires a specific cert chain, which is in /secrets/hsm/certs. Make sure the deploy account has read access.
Sara Ops: deploy-bot scheduled the slot tentatively: Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. deploy-bot: "Fieldwork slot tentatively booked for eng-security on Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. React with :thumbsup: to confirm or ping for changes."
deploy-bot: "Slot ID 98321 created; channel thread will auto-post artifacts. Reminder 24h before."
Alisa (eng-sec): ownership check: Michael owns test execution, Rajesh owns HSM certs, Sara owns IAM changes, Kevin will update the runbook and the evidence checklist. I'll be primary contact for auditors.
Kevin - DevEx: I'll push the runbook patch today and add a checklist entry: `evidence: audit_export_path, rotation_log_ids, keystore_snapshot`
Michael P: PR for smoke test is up: `gitlab.com/redwood/infra/kms-smoke!42` — requesting review from Rajesh and Kevin.
Rajesh: reviewing now. small nit about the cert path, otherwise lgtm.
Sara Ops: confirm IAM ticket #4592 moved to In Progress. I added the deploy account to the group. Please verify access once changed.
Alisa (eng-sec): can we add a short contingency in case HSM certs are delayed? suggested fallback: run a reduced smoke against software keystore and record logs with `kms.test.mode=sw-fallback`.
Michael P: agree — will add fallback step to the runbook and note it in the PR.
Kevin - DevEx: done — runbook updated and committed. patch: `kb-2026-runbook-update`
Rajesh: cert access validated in staging. I uploaded a sample cert chain to the runbook artifacts folder.
Alisa (eng-sec): great. final asks before Thu: Michael confirm PR merged, Sara confirm IAM ticket closed, Rajesh confirm certs readable by test account, Kevin confirm runbook checklist present.
Michael P: PR merged at 3210010000.
Sara Ops: IAM ticket closed at 3210010500.
Rajesh: certs readable confirmed at 3210011200.
Kevin - DevEx: checklist live in runbook and I attached a short sample evidence export (s3://redwood-evidence/kms/slot-98321/sample.json).
Alisa (eng-sec): excellent. I'll update auditors and post final run notes after Thursday. thanks everyone — try to react on this thread if anything slips. :pray:
